sections.heading: What a Mercedes Engine Rebuild Involves

blocks.html: Our engine rebuild service returns your Mercedes-Benz engine to factory specifications - or better. Every rebuild follows a strict, documented process carried out in our purpose-built workshop.

The process is not a simple “overhaul”; it is a complete disassembly, inspection, precision machining, replacement of all wear items, and reassembly to original tolerances. We use genuine or OEM-quality parts and factory-specified tools for every job.

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Assessment
steps.body: We perform a full diagnostic check and compression test to confirm rebuild requirements. We then provide a fixed-price quote before any work begins.

steps.title: Engine Removal & Strip-Down
steps.body: The engine is carefully removed and completely disassembled. All parts are cleaned using thermal and shot-blasting methods to reveal wear and damage.

steps.title: Precision Measurement & Machining
steps.body: Every component is measured to micron tolerance. Cylinders are bored and honed, crankshafts ground, and deck surfaces milled to factory specs.

steps.title: Parts Replacement & Assembly
steps.body: All wear items - bearings, piston rings, seals, gaskets - are replaced with genuine or OEM parts. Reassembly follows Mercedes-Benz torque and angle settings.

steps.title: Dyno Test & Calibration
steps.body: Every rebuilt engine is run on our dyno for a full break-in cycle. We check for leaks, verify performance, and calibrate engine management.

steps.title: Re-fit & Road Test
steps.body: The engine is re-installed, fluids filled, and a comprehensive road test is performed. Only when everything is perfect do we hand the car back.

items.q: How long does a Mercedes engine rebuild take?
items.a: Our typical rebuild time is **3-5 working days** from arrival at our workshop. This includes strip-down, machining, assembly, dyno testing, and road testing. Complex V12 or AMG engines may take longer; we will advise you when quoting.

items.q: What is included in the rebuild price?
items.a: Your fixed-price quote covers all labour, machining, new bearings, piston rings, gaskets, seals, timing chain components (where applicable), and engine oil. It also includes the 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty and dyno testing.

items.q: Do you use genuine Mercedes parts?
items.a: We use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts or OEM-quality equivalents from trusted suppliers. For critical components such as timing chains, we fit factory-spec parts to ensure long-term reliability.

items.q: Can you rebuild an AMG engine?
items.a: Yes. Our technicians are experienced with all AMG engines, including M156, M157, M177, M178, and the four-cylinder M139. We have the specialised tools and knowledge required for AMG rebuilds.

items.q: Do you collect vehicles from outside Essex?
items.a: Yes - we offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.
